scientific_integrity: The homology and lattice quotients are justified by an exact 36-by-36 integral unit minor, exhaustive finite chain calculations, and exact integer Smith normal forms. The standard graph deleted-product equivalence is cited separately. Prior rational homology and generic generating results are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Exact result for two unordered particles on the 20-vertex dodecahedral graph and tori supported on vertex-disjoint simple cycles; not a theorem for arbitrary graphs, ordered particles, or larger particle numbers. A possibly relevant 2010 dissertation was identified by abstract, but its full text was unavailable. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Integral cycle-length torus lattices in the dodecahedral two-point configuration space
